metadata_inventory.note: The public OSF inventory contains analysis datasets, yearly colonisation/extinction summaries, results, README files and code, but no separately identifiable coordinate, distance, patch-registry or site-geometry file for the 110-patch universe.

published_endpoint_evidence.reason: Published rates are not frozen lower bounds on calibration/heldout event and non-event counts. Row-level occupancy data must not be opened merely to decide eligibility.

no_rescue: do not extract coordinates from response-bearing analysis datasets
do not infer patch geometry from figures or aggregate connectivity values
do not convert colonisation rates into event counts without documented risk-set counts
do not open patch-year occupancy rows to decide candidate eligibility
do not reuse the stopped 1999-2005 69-patch response to rescue this later candidate
